title: Larkspur workflow manifest
description: What one workflow may touch. The manifest is the unit of change (chapter 2): the pipeline refuses to deploy a manifest without a change record, and the gateway and the harness enforce it at run time.

workflow.description: The workflow's name; also its gateway tag and the prefix of its identities.

owner.description: The engineer accountable for the code and the on-call.

sponsor.description: The manager accountable for the purpose, the budget and the access reviews.

data_class_max.description: The highest data class a prompt of this workflow may carry.

models.description: Gateway aliases the workflow may call. An alias remap is a model change and reruns the golden set.

regions.description: Regions a model call may be served from, fallbacks included. The gateway refuses an alias that serves outside them and disables a fallback that would.

tools.description: The allowlist: tool name to its declared arguments and whether it writes.

allow.description: Values an argument may take, enforced by the policy engine at the tool gateway (chapter 6). An argument not named here is unconstrained.

never.description: Actions no identity in the workflow's chain may perform, whatever anyone asks.

trace_content.description: Whether spans may carry prompts, outputs and tool arguments. A data-class decision.
